OurStorySection.headline: A Journey of
OurStorySection.story:
Founded in 1993 by Late Shri Vijay Shankar Yadav in a temporary space with just 30 students and a big dream, Little Flower School began its journey with a simple mission: to provide quality, value-based education that goes beyond textbooks.

Over the past three decades, we have grown from a modest neighborhood school into a network of CBSE-affiliated schools across Uttar Pradesh. What hasn't changed is our commitment to fostering a nurturing environment where every child feels valued, encouraged, and challenged to achieve their best.

leaders.name: Late Vijay Shankar Yadav Ji
leaders.quote: The foundation of Little Flower's educational journey was laid by Late Shiksha Ratan Vijay Shankar Yadav Ji, whose belief in the importance of education continues to remain part of the institution's identity.

leaders.name: Mr. Muralidhar Yadav
leaders.role: Chairman, Little Flower Group of Schools
leaders.bio:
At Little Flower, we believe that the true purpose of education is to prepare children not only for examinations, but for the opportunities and responsibilities that lie ahead.

Our journey has always been guided by a commitment to provide quality education while creating an environment where students can develop knowledge, character, confidence and a sense of responsibility.

We are proud of the journey Little Flower has undertaken so far, but we also recognise that education is constantly evolving. Our responsibility is to keep learning, improving and creating better opportunities for every student who becomes a part of the Little Flower family.

We look forward to continuing this journey with the trust and support of our students, parents, educators and communities.

leaders.name: Sharman Joshi
leaders.quote: Some journeys are worth supporting because of the trust behind them.
leaders.bio:
I am happy to extend my support to Little Flower Children School and its journey towards making quality education accessible to more children and families.

Over the years, LFCS has built a foundation of trust and goodwill through its commitment to education and the communities it serves.

What encouraged me to be a part of this journey is the purpose behind it to take that experience and commitment to more communities across India.

Education has the power to shape lives, open possibilities and create a stronger future. Initiatives that work towards making that opportunity more accessible deserve encouragement and support.

I wish the LFCS team the very best as they take this important step forward, and I am glad to be associated with this journey.

leaders.name: Mr. Anand Kumar
leaders.quote: Education can change the direction of a child's life. But for that change to happen, quality education must reach the children who need it.
leaders.bio:
I am happy to support Little Flower Children Schools and its vision of taking accessible and structured education to more communities.

What resonates with me is the belief that every child deserves an opportunity to learn, explore & discover their potential and move forward with confidence.

I wish LFCS the very best as it takes this important vision to more children and families across India.

leaders.name: Ms. Manju Rana
leaders.bio:
Felicitated with the National Award for Teachers by the President of India in 2018 for her contribution in the field of education for over 34 years.

Former Director of the Seth Anandram Jaipuria Group of Schools, with extensive experience in academics, strategic planning, and administrative management.

Worked closely with premier educational bodies like CBSE, British Council, NPSC, and Sahodaya Schools Complex.

A CBSE expert trainer and auditor, delivering workshops on educational leadership and publishing insightful articles in national publications.

faqs.a: Recruitment and training support, if available, will be provided according to the applicable partnership terms.

faqs.q: How long does it take to start a school?
faqs.a: The timeline depends on location, approvals, infrastructure development, staffing and other project requirements.

faqs.q: Does LFCS assist with admissions and marketing?
faqs.a: Support for admissions and marketing will depend on the agreed partnership scope.

faqs.q: Can I start an LFCS school in my city?
faqs.a: You can submit an enquiry with your proposed location. The LFCS team can review the details and discuss the applicable requirements.

faqs.q: How can I enquire about starting an LFCS school?
faqs.a: Complete the enquiry form on this page, and the relevant team can contact you regarding your proposal.
